comment: Presented images (SPEC 6, E24). Every case claims to be the seal of data 'Hello', kind ''. png_base64 is the presented file. GENUINE: a verifiable PNG whose pixels are the genuine seal; MISMATCH: a verifiable PNG of other pixels; REJECTED: not a verifiable PNG, the wrong size, or non-uniform upscale blocks. 'rule' names the erratum that decides the case, or is null for behaviour every conforming verifier already has.
